gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.circleHint: Then, if you like, add a loved one in “My Circle”.

welcome.lead: Your medications, on time. Your loved ones, reassured.
welcome.remindersBody: Even without internet, with the phone locked or after a restart. One tap is enough to say “Taken”.
welcome.circleTitle: Your loved ones can look out for you
welcome.circleBody: If a dose is not confirmed, the people you choose get a notification on their phone. Never with the name of your medications.
welcome.privacyBody: Encrypted on your phone, backed up in Europe, never sold. You can export or delete everything.

signIn.title: Welcome to DoseCircle
signIn.intro: Enter your email address: we will send you a 6-digit code. No password to remember.
signIn.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, for example mary@example.com.
signIn.consentRequired: Please agree to the processing of your health data to continue.
signIn.consent: I agree that DoseCircle stores my treatments and dose times to send me reminders.

remindersCheck.truncated: (the next ones will be scheduled automatically)

collected.title: What we store
collected.body: Your email address, your medications and times as you enter them, your answers to reminders, your first name and, if you invite any, the link with the loved ones who look out for you (their first name only).

why.title: Why
why.body: Only to remind you of your doses, back up your data, and alert the loved ones you have chosen. No selling, no profiling.

ads.title: Advertising (free version)
ads.body: The free version shows a few ads (Google AdMob), non-personalized only and after your consent. Your health data is never shared with ad networks: they do not know you take a treatment. Premium removes all ads; the purchase is handled by the App Store or Google Play, through RevenueCat.

where.title: Where your data is
where.body: On your phone (encrypted database) and on our servers in Europe (Supabase). Alerts to loved ones go through the notification services of Expo, Apple and Google, crash reports through Sentry (without any health data), ads through Google AdMob and the subscription through RevenueCat.

howLong.title: For how long
howLong.body: As long as your account exists. When you delete it, all your data is erased immediately from our servers and from this phone.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: From “My account”: export all your data, delete your account. You can also write to us with any question, and contact your data protection authority.

notMedical.title: DoseCircle is not a medical device
notMedical.body: The app reminds you of what you entered. It gives no medical advice and checks neither doses nor interactions. If in doubt, ask your doctor or pharmacist.

account.localData: Your medications are saved on this phone, encrypted, and backed up online whenever there is a network. They remain available offline.
account.signOutBody: You will no longer receive any medication reminders on this phone until you sign in again.
account.signOutPending: Some changes are not backed up online yet: they stay on this phone and will be sent the next time you sign in.
account.deleteBody: Your medications, history, Circle and settings will be erased from this phone and from our servers. Your reminders will stop and your loved ones will no longer be alerted. This cannot be undone: export your data first if needed.
account.deleteSubscription: Your Premium subscription is not cancelled by this deletion: cancel it in your App Store or Google Play settings.

premium.title: DoseCircle Premium
premium.noAds: ✓ No ads, anywhere in the app
premium.freeForAll: Reminders, history and the Circle stay free for everyone.

premium.legal: The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period, at the same price, unless cancelled at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your App Store or Google Play account, where you can manage or cancel the subscription at any time. Deleting the app or your DoseCircle account does not cancel the subscription.
